subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should explicit Telegram `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")` create and bind a child forum topic for subagent sessions, or should Telegram keep current-conversation binding as the supported behavior unless a narrower opt-in is designed?
rationale: Current main has the generic session-binding adapter path and Telegram child-topic primitives, but Telegram’s default placement remains current and the open implementation candidate changes user-visible forum-topic behavior that overlaps with a separate request to avoid exposing internal subagent threads.

options.title: Sponsor narrowed child-topic support
options.body: Repair or replace the open Telegram PR so explicit subagent thread spawns can create child forum topics while ordinary Telegram binding stays current.

options.title: Keep current-conversation only
options.body: Document that Telegram binds subagent sessions to the current conversation/topic and does not create child forum topics by default.

options.title: Defer to channel policy design
options.body: Hold this behind broader thread-binding policy/API work before changing Telegram routing semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrowed child-topic support
recommendation.body: Repair or replace the open Telegram PR so explicit subagent thread spawns can create child forum topics while ordinary Telegram binding stays current.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice extends the core SessionBindingService direction from PR 88416, which this owner authored.
